test_title: PYST 1: SSC GD Constable 2025 - Reasoning (Held On: 04 Feb, 2025 - Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Eight people are sitting in two parallel rows containing 4 people each in such a way that there is equal distance between adjacent persons.

In row 1, D, E, O and S are seated and all of them are facing south.

In row 2, F, A, R and M are seated and all of them are facing north.

Thus, each person faces another person from the other row.

Only D sits to the left of E. Only R sits to the left of A. Only one person sits between A and F. Only one person sits between D and O.

Which of the following represents both people facing each other?
solution:
Given: Eight people are sitting in two parallel rows containing 4 people each in such a way that there is equal distance between adjacent persons. Thus, each person faces another person from the other row.

In row 1, D, E, O and S are seated and all of them are facing south.

In row 2, F, A, R and M are seated and all of them are facing north.

1) Only D sits to the left of E.

2) Only R sits to the left of A.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b13d6557bcc444b93b4954dcab8d83a1d3e60ff8173d2a2e9fe5f992935ae5e6.png] 

3) Only one person sits between A and F.

After positioning F only one position is left in row - 2 which will be occupied by the only person left i.e. M.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aeb57ae1c3acde30122c7a53e9043dc8ef42dfdb952fcea5c789e7502abcc03b.png] 

4) Only one person sits between D and O.

After positioning O only one position is left in row - 1 which will be occupied by the only person left i.e. S.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/24a08889883afc2f1b9d5535d7396cedf2ce7c6532a2cb8b33bda196b230703c.png] 

Thus, according to the final arrangement E and M face each other.

Hence, **"Option 2"** is the correct answer.
